messages.author: 4a0d6ff9ce3b1d6b
messages.subject: I can't compute standard errors 2
parts:
Dear, lavaan community members,

This question is continue of  my first question (the last one is https://groups.google.com/d/msgid/lavaan/CAJc%3DyOH2vw_HXQ8hNP0fO8XVBNK88WV%3DrQO2%3DznMj_5EVQ0nHg%40mail.gmail.com?utm_medium=email&utm_source=footer).

I had a problem with computing standard error in running SEM(cross-lagged effect model).
The following was my code:
  model2009 <-'
    #factor analysis(latent variables)
    internal1 =~1*INFLU1+COMPLEX1
    institution1 =~ 1*PARTY1+ELECTION1+CONGRESS1
    internal2 =~1*INFLU2+COMPLEX2
    institution2 =~ 1*PARTY2+ELECTION2+CONGRESS2

   #unique variances of observed variables
    INFLU1~~INFLU1; COMPLEX1~~COMPLEX1; PARTY1~~PARTY1;                 ELECTION1~~ELECTION1; CONGRESS1~~CONGRESS1
    INFLU2~~INFLU2; COMPLEX2~~COMPLEX2; PARTY2~~PARTY2;       ELECTION2~~ELECTION2; CONGRESS2~~CONGRESS2

   #structural equation
    internal2~internal1+institution1;
    institution2~internal1+institution1;

   #covariances between latent variables
    internal1~~institution1; internal2~~institution2; internal1~~internal1;         institution1~~institution1; internal2~~internal2; institution2~~institution2v
'

Thanks to community member's advice, I found not confining the coefficient disturbed identifying the models.
So I improved the model part as following:
  internal1 =~1*INFLU1+a*COMPLEX1
  institution1 =~ 1*PARTY1+b*ELECTION1+c*CONGRESS1
  internal2 =~1*INFLU2+a*COMPLEX2
  institution2 =~ 1*PARTY2+b*ELECTION2+c*CONGRESS2

But I still have an error message.
The error message is
  Gamma.g * tcrossprod(a1) でerror:  適切な配列ではありません (in English; The arrangement is not proper.)

How should I solve this? 
Best wishes, 
 Ashu
